_about: Spelling map for the v2 (LatinCy 3.9.8) lemmas, checked against every candidate's passages (results/a1_v2/variant_contexts.txt). Applied after lowercase + v->u + j->i. Delete a line to reject it. 3.9.8 already merges uoltus/uultus, uolnus/uulnus, uolgus/uulgus and thorus/torus itself.
_finding: In most groups the texts do not contain two spellings: 3.9.8 gives identical surface spellings two different lemma spellings (exstinguo and extinguo both for extinct-/extingu-; arundo and harundo both for harundo; arena and harena both for harenas; exspecto and expecto both for expect-). So the groups are merged and the canonical form follows the texts, not 3.9.8.
_rule: canonical = the spelling the texts use most often (counted by tokens); ties go to the classical/assimilated form (irritus 3:3, lympha 1:1).

_evidence.adsum: text: ad- 59 tokens (aderit, adest, ades, adsum), as- 2 (Ecerinis assint)
_evidence.exilium: text: exil- 21 (noun); kept apart from the verb exilio 'leap out'
_evidence.sepio: text: sep- 2 (septus, sepire), saep- 1 (saeptam); all 'fence in, surround'
_evidence.lympha: text: 1:1 (Ecerinis limphis, Oedipus lympha); tie -> classical spelling
_evidence.harundo: text: harund- 8; both 3.9.8 lemmas cover the same spelling
_evidence.harena: text: haren- 7; both 3.9.8 lemmas cover the same spelling
_evidence.irritus: text: irrit- 3, inrit- 3; tie -> assimilated; 'hirritus' is not a word
_evidence.exilio: the 5 tokens are the verb 'leap out' (exilit, exiliat, exiluit), not the noun exilium

_rejected._note: Different words, confirmed in context. Where one side is a lemma error, the fix is proposed in data/v2/lemma_fixes_v2.csv.
_rejected.cedo/caedo: yield (cessit, cedendum) vs cut/kill (caesus, caedite); the caedo forms cecidi/ceciderant may belong to cado and go to the lemma review
_rejected.annus/anus: year vs old woman (Alcmena: quas petam terras anus)
_rejected.committo/comito: comitata/comitantem belong to comitor 'accompany' (lemma fix proposed)
_rejected.uelo/uello: veil vs pluck (uulsa, uulsos); Medea 'sipara uelo' is the noun uelum (lemma fix proposed)
_rejected.immitto/imito: imitare belongs to imitor 'imitate' (lemma fix proposed)
_rejected.hio/io: Phaedra 'Ius' is a garbled token, not the interjection io
_rejected.leo/loeo: Agamemnon 'loeas' is a garbled 'locas' (loco) (lemma fix proposed)
_rejected.coetus/coaetus: Thyestes 'coaetos' is a garbled 'coactos' (cogo) (lemma fix proposed)
